device_name: CD Horizon ModuLeX 5.5 Spinal System with NanoLOCK

specs.Features: Detachable/ Modular Head , Polyaxial Head , Medial Cortical Screw , Self Tapping

description: The CD Horizon ModuLeX 5.5 Spinal system by Medtronic is a complete thoracolumbar fixation system using the 5.5mm rod system. It features pedicle screws for use in the traditional pedicle screw as well as the medial cortical screw. In addition If features the option for Osteogrip threadform which has a cortical and cancellous thread.
features: Cortical Shank: optimized for medial cortical screw placement
ATS (Awl Tip Screw): dual thread with self-drilling and self-tapping screw
Osteogrip: Dual thread features a 51% toggle reduction
Osteogrip with nanoLOCK: Surface etched with Titan NanoLOCK technology for increased fixation that acts as an osteoconductive scaffold for bony ingrowth.
